mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, real_name, department, user_role, created_at, updated_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password, real_name, department, user_role, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{department}, #{userRole}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, real_name = #{realName}, department = #{department}, user_role = #{userRole}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
